title: Glycans modulate lipid binding in Lili-Mip lipocalin protein
authors: Harini SureshKumar; Rajeswari Appadurai; Anand Srivastava
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟研究糖基化对Lili-Mip脂质结合蛋白动态和脂质结合的影响，虽为蛋白质-配体互作而非TF-DNA体系，但其糖基化调控结合口袋动态的机制和MD方法可迁移至蛋白质-DNA互作研究。
abstract: The unique viviparous Pacific Beetle cockroaches provide nutrition to their embryo by secreting milk proteins Lili-Mip, which is a lipid-binding glycoprotein that crystallizes in vivo. The resolved in vivo crystal structure of variably glycosylated Lili-Mip shows a classical Lipocalin fold with an eight-stranded antiparallel beta-barrel enclosing a fatty acid. The availability of physiologically unaltered glycoprotein structure makes Lili-Mip a very attractive model system to investigate the role of glycans on protein structure, dynamics, and function. Towards that end, we have employed all-atom molecular dynamics simulations on various glycosylated stages of a bound and free Lili-Mip protein and characterized the impact of glycans and the bound lipid on the dynamics of this glycoconjugate. Our work provides important molecular-level mechanistic insights into the role of glycans in the nutrient storage function of the Lili-Mip protein. Our analyses show that the glycans locally stabilize spatially proximal residues and regulate the low amplitude opening motions of the residues at the entrance of the binding pocket. Glycans, which are located at the portal end of the barrel, also restrict the distal barrel depth and allosterically modulate the lipid dynamics in the barrel. A simple but effective distance-based network analysis of the protein also reveals the role of glycans in the subtle rewiring of residues crucial for determining the barrel depth and lipid orientation.
abstract_zh: 独特的胎生太平洋甲虫蟑螂通过分泌乳汁蛋白Lili-Mip为其胚胎提供营养，这是一种在体内结晶的脂质结合糖蛋白。已解析的、具有可变糖基化的Lili-Mip体内晶体结构显示出经典的Lipocalin折叠，包含一个八股反平行β-桶，内部包裹着一分子脂肪酸。生理状态下未改变的糖蛋白结构的可用性，使Lili-Mip成为研究聚糖对蛋白质结构、动力学和功能影响的极具吸引力的模型系统。为此，我们采用全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，对结合态和游离态Lili-Mip蛋白的不同糖基化阶段进行了研究，并表征了聚糖和结合脂质对该糖缀合物动力学的影响。我们的工作提供了重要的分子层面机制性见解，揭示了聚糖在Lili-Mip蛋白营养储存功能中的作用。分析表明，聚糖局部稳定了空间上邻近的残基，并调节了结合口袋入口处残基的低幅度开合运动。位于桶状结构门户端的聚糖还限制了远端桶深度，并变构调节桶内脂质的动力学。对蛋白质进行的简单而有效的基于距离的网络分析，也揭示了聚糖在微妙重连残基中的作用，这些残基对决定桶深度和脂质取向至关重要。
